correctness.rationale: For each axis i, condition on its Gaussian coefficient x; a sign-vector edge crosses iff |sum_{j != i} eps_j Z_j|<|x|, and the conditional mean of the normalized count is p_m(x)=2 Phi(|x|/sqrt(m))-1, m=n-1. The centered threshold indicator is even; its Hermite expansion has no odd or zeroth coefficients, so for sign vectors with correlation rho the indicator covariance is between zero and rho^2 p_m(x). Averaging rho^2 exactly over all sign-vector pairs gives 1/m, hence Var(X|Z_i=x)<=p_m(x)/m without false independence. The integral representation sqrt(m)p_m(x)=sqrt(2/pi) int_0^{|x|}exp(-t^2/(2m))dt bounds squared L2 bias by 5/(6pi m^2) using E|Z|^6=15. Also E p_m(Z)=2/pi arctan(1/sqrt(m)), yielding the stated full error bound. Sum over fixed r gives joint L2, then exact first/second moments and zero cross-covariance limits. Independent cube-edge endpoint enumeration matched the threshold identity for dimensions 3..7; finite tests do not prove the asymptotic theorem.
